scope: All20 source units covering printed labels1–22 on A2 PDF29–30. This is a bounded second visual comparison, not a whole-book review.

findings.description: The print has a discrete yod between the two resh letters. Retain this full spelling; do not normalize to the defective spelling used in the draft. This finding concerns the additional printed consonant; the surrounding marks are retained from the draft after visual comparison.
findings.resolution: Root independently confirmed the source yod in בשרירות and applied בִּשְׁרִירוּת. Checked current chapter1 snapshot contains it.

queries.currentReading: Jerusalem forms use lamed patah alone.
queries.question: In the tightly cropped 1:6–7 בירושלם, the lamed mark looks like a horizontal mark with a short stem, accompanied by a separate dot to its left. Determine whether the print has qamats plus hiriq, patah plus hiriq, or only patah with incidental ink. Compare each occurrence independently; the earlier user interpretation for 1MA is not authority for these BAR instances.
queries.resolution: The shown1:6–7 crop is read by the user as qamats+hiriq, with the optional simplification wording preserved verbatim in the decision file. Both printed marks are retained. The other listed1:2/9/15 occurrences were separately compared by the root reviewer; no global replacement.

queries.question: The yod shewa is visible; the separate lamed patah is not independently distinct from the lower lamed stroke to this reader. Confirm the printed lamed vowel without supplying conventional pointing.
queries.resolution: User identifies patah under lamed in the shown ירושלימה; existing יְרוּשָׁלַיְמָה retained.

queries.question: The current draft includes yod dagesh in these names. The enlarged scan shows the yod and qamats, but a distinct dagesh dot cannot be separated confidently from its thick body in these two crops. Retain as provisional pending a second reading; no proposed deletion solely because the scan is thick.
queries.resolution: User says the yod seems to have dagesh in both shown names. Existing dagesh retained; the qualified seems wording is preserved rather than promoted to unambiguous visual certainty.

resolvedChecks.detail: The enlarged מחסיהו supports the existing hataf-patah under het in מַחֲסֵיָהוּ; no replacement with simple shewa is proposed.
Keep the source consonants למקטן and existing provisional לְמִקָּטֹן; do not substitute the more familiar למקטון/מקטן wording. זקנים and סוד match the source.
The source name consonants are יויקים, חלקיה and שלום; no modernization of the names is indicated. Two sof-pasuq clauses remain inside the printed combined unit.
The source ויבאם has no inserted vav or yod mater beyond these consonants. Current וַיְבִאֵם is retained.
The source brackets around בבואכם and the existing להתודות consonants/pointing are retained. No extra yod or change of the vav vowel is justified.

The print distinguishes defective אבתינו in16–17 and19 from full אבותינו in20. The current draft preserves that distinction. Preserve both clauses in combined16–17, separate19 and20, and the brackets within19.
